output.brief: The 22 Oct miss was caused by the Q3 margin restatement backfill, not by platform trouble or customer_ltv. The backfill started at 00:58 and held an exclusive lock on stage_orders until 04:18. The nightly merge waited 2h13m for it. The rest of the run took its normal time, and the lock wait alone explains the roughly one-hour overrun. The Corvane incident (02:52–03:37) fell inside the wait, and the log shows no slowdown from it. customer_ltv adds only about 19 minutes, and data volume was normal, so a tier upgrade or removing customer_ltv would not fix this. Removing customer_ltv would also hurt the retention team's 08:00 call list. Keep the banner: it stopped Finance from publishing stale numbers as current. Recommended action: make the job owner a required reviewer for changes touching its tables, bar writes to those tables from 01:00 to 06:00 without owner sign-off, and alert on lock waits over 15 minutes. Don't discipline D. Varga yet. The change was approved for 13:00–17:00, but why it ran at 01:00 is unconfirmed. The '1:00' note could be a misreading of 13:00, or a deliberate choice, and the repository history doesn't say. The review process also never listed the job owner. Ask Varga when they return from leave. I'm confident about the main cause and less sure about the reason for the start time.
